lead.description: Project Manager — primary agent. Nhận mục tiêu sprint, phân task, điều phối các subagent, theo dõi tiến độ, tổng hợp và kiểm tra kết quả.

arch.description: Architecture & Integration Reviewer — data contracts, module boundaries, API contract (OpenAPI/Swagger), cross-system consistency.

backend.description: Backend Specialist — Node.js + Express, REST API (/api/v1), auth (Supabase JWT), CRUD modules: employees, customers, vouchers, bookings, posts, holidays, templates, settings, dashboard.

frontend.description: Frontend Specialist — React + TailwindCSS, React Router, các trang: Dashboard, Employees, Customers, Vouchers, Bookings, Posts, Holidays, Messages, Reports, Settings. Responsive + loading states + error handling.

database.description: Database Specialist — PostgreSQL/Supabase, thiết kế schema (11 bảng), migration SQL, RLS policies, index, triggers (tự động tăng total_visits/total_spent), Supabase Auth.

automation.description: Automation Specialist — node-cron (8:00 AM daily), Zalo OA API (gửi tin + webhook follow), Gmail SMTP fallback (nodemailer), logic sinh nhật/ngày lễ/nhắc khách quay lại, template rendering ({{customer_name}}, {{voucher_code}}).

devops.description: DevOps Specialist — deploy Frontend lên Vercel, deploy Backend lên Railway/Render, environment variables, Cloudinary setup, monitoring (Sentry free), GitHub repo + CI/CD.

qa.description: QA & Testing Specialist — test API (Postman collection), test UI (CRUD flow), test automation (cron, Zalo, Gmail), edge cases (voucher hết lượt/hết hạn, fallback Zalo→Email), Jest unit tests.
